get.summary: Get the caller's inference session history
get.description:
The caller's inference session history, including finished sessions.

Complements `/inference/loaded-models`, which returns open sessions only.
A failed deployment is closed the moment the monitoring service reports it,
so a failure never appears there — but its error text is recorded and is
what this endpoint exists to make reachable.

Newest first, paginated with a keyset cursor. `include_status`,
`include_error`, and `include_billing` are opt-in. The error text is
unbounded and never truncated; request it for one session or alongside
`?status=error`.

Take a `session_id` from here to call `/runtime/status` for one session's
live state.

schema.description: Page size.

schema.description: Cursor: return sessions older than this id. Take it from next_cursor. Keyset rather than an offset, so a session created while paginating cannot shift or duplicate rows.

InferenceSession.title: InferenceSession
InferenceSession.description:
One inference session, whether open or already closed.

``status`` and ``error`` are deliberately optional *response fields*.
Billing fields follow the same rule. They are omitted unless the caller
asks for them, so a history page does not have to transport operational
state, potentially very large failure logs, or replica-meter calculations
for every old session.

InferenceStatusEnum.title: InferenceStatusEnum
InferenceStatusEnum.description:
Status values for inference sessions.

Values:
    pending: Model is registered but waiting to start loading
    running: Model is actively running and serving requests
    failed: Model failed during loading or execution
    completed: Model completed successfully
    stopped: Model was deliberately stopped by an administrator
